columns.name: ACTION_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This column will be used to store the primary key of this table. Auto Generated Key.

columns.name: SUBSCRIBER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the information about the subscriber for which this action item is supposed to be displayed. Lookup used for this - ORA_IRC_RAC_SUBSCRIBER

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: This column stores the object id for a given subsriber. For eg - If Subscriber is SUBMISSIONS , then it will be submissionId . If subscriber is OFFER then it will be offerId etc.

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: Subject associated to the OBJECT_ID for which the Action Item applies

columns.name: SUBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Subject type associated to the OBJECT_ID for which the Action Item applies

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the date when the action was supposed to be taken care of.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of each action item.Lookup used - ORA_IRC_ACTION_ITEM_STATUS

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: If this action item was executed by the ESS Job , the respective request id will be stored here.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
